## Issue 1: set_outlier bug

use reprex::reprex for git hub 
tramo(
  ts,
  spec = c("trfull", "tr0", "tr1", "tr2", "tr3", "tr4", "tr5"),
  context = NULL,
  userdefined = NULL
)

```{r}
reprex::reprex()

library("rjd3toolkit")
library("rjd3tramoseats")
myspec_ts <- tramoseats_spec("rsafull") 

# before modifying spec 
myspec_ts$tramo$outlier$ao 
myspec_ts$tramo$outlier$ls 
myspec_ts$tramo$outlier$tc
myspec_ts$tramo$outlier$so

myspec_ts <- set_outlier(
  myspec_ts,
  outliers.type = "AO"
)

# after modifying spec 
myspec_ts$tramo$outlier$ao 
myspec_ts$tramo$outlier$ls 
myspec_ts$tramo$outlier$tc
myspec_ts$tramo$outlier$so

```
